title: [RP/CIT] CYT players totems
description: A RP that adds totems of players that plays on CYT server (and other)
body:
# A RP that will add totems with players textures, using CIT (by rename)

To change totem's texture, you need to rename it like in anvil, renamed item will have another texture if u have Requirements, its a totem that looks like a totem and a player in a time so u can make totem of you (see down how to be in rp) and if other players have the rp, they'll see it too

- [X] !! If u want to be in rp, or ure already and u want to be deleted/edit skin, Message me in discord, my name in ds is `antivirusniy_gus`
- [X] !! Every totem name can be found in README.md file in zip archive

Requirements:
- [X] U need have Optifine (For forge)/[CIT Resewn (For fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) mod to use this RP
